wave.notes: SEE ranges_note. Truth = FUNC symbols of the tbs-en ELF built on nih-vps-u (`make compare-tbs-en`, out/tbs-en/tbs-en.gba: OK, sha1 5c4695... = rom.sha1 for tbs-en). The English edition links unported code through a scaffold (`recon/tbs/unidentified.o`, `.incbin "baserom.gba"` of raw ROM spans): functions in games/ objects (C or proven assembly) are the repo's compiled truth; 189 `recon/tbs/raw/*.s` listings are not-yet-C code whose function boundaries come only from the repo's own analysis (verified=0). verified=1 only for units compiled from games/**/*.C (2072 of 2747); games/**/*.S assembly units and recon raw are 0. 651 functions (mostly hand-written asm) have no ELF size (0). The 96 code overlays (resource_36f..3ce) are packed ROM resources (a scene loader's own codec, not the BIOS LZ77) unpacked to 0x02008000 at runtime; the main ELF has no symbols for them, so their rows come from the per-overlay link outputs of the same build (out/tbs-en/overlays/resource_<id>.elf: every FUNC symbol, address with the Thumb bit cleared, ELF size (0 when sizeless), name; two symbols at one address keep the sized, global one) as modules ov0..ov95 (ov<N> = resource id 0x36f+N, ROM order). verified follows the same unit rule as main (1: the object is compiled from a games/**/*.C unit, 0: assembly, listings and library members), read from each overlay's linker map. 9,137 rows, 3,686 verified, 0 sized rows overlapping a successor. IWRAM-resident code (.iwram_runtime VMA 0x03000000, .iwram_mixer VMA 0x03007000) is keyed by its ROM load address (3 functions VMA!=LMA). linked_percent is decomp.dev's 89.93% (all six editions, project-wide); this edition's own C coverage of its analysed code is verified/functions above. No DWARF, so no types/.

wave.compiler: old_agbcc (Dream-Atelier/agbcc submodule a0f70c9, -O2), arm-none-eabi binutils; libgcc/newlib members compiled from tools/agbcc
wave.notes: Truth = FUNC symbols of the ELF relinked on nih-vps-u (ROM sha1 identical to the delivered file; the repo's `make check` second step (code-mask hash against nascar-heat.code.sha1) failed in this host environment with sha1sum "no properly formatted checksum lines" via my shasum shim, after the byte-identical ROM check itself had passed). The build has three load regions: the main image (0x08000000..0x08339780, 0x08364ac8..), a `.high_module` (VMA 0x02000d00, LMA 0x08339780) and an `.island` (VMA 0x02000000, LMA 0x08363ee8). start addresses of the main-image rows are ROM addresses; the 456 functions with VMA!=LMA (their VMA is in EWRAM) are keyed here by VMA (their module is the RomWright module row `gba:ram.<run base>` of the `gba` program; the LMA-keyed rows are in functions.rom-keyed.tsv, same names, sizes and verified flags). The mapping is the section table of this note: .high_module LMA 0x08339780..0x08363ee8 -> VMA 0x02000d00, .island LMA 0x08363ee8..0x08364ac8 -> VMA 0x02000000 (the main image resumes at 0x08364ac8). `gba:ram.02000b96` is how RomWright names the module image it places from ROM 0x339616 at run base 0x02000b96 (its decoded code starts a little below the section's VMA); the .island module is `gba:ram.02000000`. 8 asm functions carry no size (0); two m4a asm labels (ld_r3_tp_adr_i copies) overlap their successor in the ELF and were set to size 0. verified=1 only for units compiled from src/*.c. No DWARF, so no types/.
